pages.text: $(l)Mystical Agriculture$() lets you $(l)farm your resources$(). Essence crops grown from special seeds yield iron, diamonds and most modded metals, turning mining into farming.$(br2)That makes it the mod most likely to break an economy, so its pricing is the most conservative here.

The essence ladder is pinned rung by rung, inferium at $(l)Tier 1$() up to supremium at $(l)Tier 5$(), so climbing it can never mint filament. $(l)Mystical Agradditions$() is a separate hook and its Nether and End ores are priced the same way.$(br2)Everything awakened is left $(l)unvalued$(): the Awakening Altar is a recipe the valuator cannot read, and that progression gate holds.
pages.title: Values

pages.text: The crops themselves are not pinned; the general rule covers them. A planted crop costs its $(l)seed$(), and seeds cannot be wound back into filament.$(br2)A farm that made its own seeds would otherwise print money, which is exactly the hole this mod would have found first.
pages.title: The Crops
